description:
The Medek Wabidu trail and salmon viewing platforms are located on Quadra Island in a small narrow creek valley with sandy clay walls and a dense ground cover of large sword ferns. Large big leaf maple, fir, hemlock and red alder shade the valley and creek providing good salmon habitat.

An easy 320 meter loop trail starts at the trail sign half way up the side of the valley and heads gently east with good views over Hyacinthe Creek. In the fall, it provides high views down to bald eagles roosting in the trees and feeding on chum salmon carcasses along the stream edge. The east end of the trail drops down to stream level and three viewing platforms at the edge of the stream. The platforms provide good, close-up views of chum salmon spawning in October and November. The trail continues west past the three platforms to climb half way up the side of the valley to a cedar slab bench shaded by a huge big leaf maple and back to the trail head.
directions: The Medek Wabidu Trail and salmon viewing platforms are located 5 km north of Heriot Bay on Hyacinth Bay Rd. A small level pullout suitable for parking 3 cars is located at the bottom of the hill as you approach the creek on the left hand side of the road. The trail head and sign is a 2 minute walk up the east side of Hyacinth Bay Rd.
title: Medek Wabidu
